changes: REMOVED Jelgava (LV). The Truck Simulator Wiki (Fandom) lists Latvia's in-game cities as Daugavpils, Liepāja, Rēzekne, Rīga, Valmiera and Ventspils (6). A recent country guide also gives Latvia 6 DLC cities. No source names Jelgava as an in-game city. With it removed, BtBS has 35 cities (FI 10, EE 6, LV 6, LT 7, RU 6), which matches the 35 the wiki gives and closes the earlier 35-vs-36 question.
ROADS: Rīga–Jelgava (45) and Jelgava–Šiauliai (80) replaced by one edge, Rīga–Šiauliai 128 km on A8/E77 via Jelgava, then A12. The real road distance is about 125-130 km.

ROADS: Tornio–Tromsø (600, low) split at Karesuando (SE) into Tornio–Karesuando 310 (E8 via Pello, Kolari, Muonio and Kaaresuvanto) and Karesuando–Tromsø 300 (E8 via Kilpisjärvi and Skibotn). Evidence: the wiki.gg Karesuando page calls it a Nordic Horizons city in northern Sweden whose roads run south to Kiruna and north towards Finland and Norway. Karesuando is the in-game name for Kaaresuvanto (the radio_only FI candidate), so Kaaresuvanto is not added as a separate FI city. Both edges are conf low.

CONFIRMED Finland at 23 cities with the DLC split already in the dataset. The Truck Simulator Wiki Finland landmarks page puts Helsinki, Kotka, Kouvola, Lahti, Loviisa, Naantali, Pori, Tampere, Turku and Olkiluoto in BtBS. It puts Ivalo, Joensuu, Jyväskylä, Kajaani, Kokkola, Kuopio, Kuusamo, Lappeenranta, Mikkeli, Oulu, Rovaniemi, Tornio and Vaasa in Nordic Horizons. A country guide also gives 23 for Finland. Lappeenranta conf medium -> high (Nordic Horizons). SCS blog posts confirm Rovaniemi (Aug 2024), Oulu (Jan 2025) and Tornio/Haparanda (May 2025).

NOT ADDED (FI radio_only): Alajärvi, Hämeenlinna, Kemi, Kemijärvi, Kristiinankaupunki, Kärsämäki, Porvoo, Suomussalmi, Vantaa, Varkaus and Viitasaari. The vanilla list of 23 is fixed by the wiki grouping and the guide count, so these are ProMods or scenery towns. Kaaresuvanto is the Finnish name of SE Karesuando (see above).

CONFIRMED Estonia at 6 cities: the Truck Simulator Wiki Estonia navigation lists Kunda, Narva, Paldiski, Pärnu, Tallinn and Tartu. Tartu, Narva and Paldiski conf medium -> high. NOT ADDED (EE radio_only): Haapsalu, Kuressaare, Kärdla, Rakvere and Valga, all ProMods.

CONFIRMED Latvia at 6 cities (see the Jelgava entry). Ventspils, Liepāja, Daugavpils, Rēzekne and Valmiera conf medium -> high. NOT ADDED (LV radio_only): Balvi, Gulbene, Jēkabpils, Kolka, Ogre, Saldus, Tukums and Valka, all ProMods. The wiki lists only 13 Latvian scenery villages.

CONFIRMED Lithuania at 7 cities: the Truck Simulator Wiki lists Kaunas, Klaipėda, Mažeikiai, Panevėžys, Šiauliai, Utena and Vilnius. The wiki.gg Mažeikiai page and the GamePressure Utena description back this up. Šiauliai, Mažeikiai and Utena conf medium/low -> high. NOT ADDED (LT radio_only): Naujieji Valkininkai and Tauragė.

CONFIRMED Russia at 6 cities: GamePressure lists Saint Petersburg, Kaliningrad, Luga, Pskov, Sosnovy Bor and Vyborg, and a guide also counts 6. NOT ADDED (RU radio_only): Zelenogradsk and Chernyakhovsk (ProMods). 'Выборг' is the Cyrillic name of Vyborg and is now added to its aliases.
Utena roads: Kaunas–Utena conf low -> medium and Utena–Daugavpils medium -> high. The wiki.gg A6 (Lithuania) page splits A6 into Kaunas to western Utena and eastern Utena to Latvia.

Kaliningrad cross-border roads: Kaliningrad–Kaunas low -> medium (wiki.gg E28/A229: Chernyshevskoye/Kybartai crossing; A7 from Kybartai to A5 south of Kaunas). Kaliningrad–Šiauliai low -> medium (wiki.gg A216 runs from Sovetsk on the Lithuanian border to A229; Lithuanian A12 runs through Šiauliai to the Kaliningrad border). Kaliningrad–Gdańsk now notes the in-game Mamonovo/Grzechotki crossing (wiki.gg A229 page) and the road label is reordered. Kaliningrad–Olsztyn stays low: wiki.gg names no Bezledy crossing.

Pskov–Rēzekne conf low -> medium. The GamePressure border guide says BtBS has crossings on Russia's borders with Finland, Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania and Poland, so a Pskov–Latvia link exists. The exact crossing is still unverified.

Ferries: Ventspils–Nynäshamn low -> high (wiki.gg ferry table, about 8h30, needs Scandinavia). Liepāja–Travemünde medium -> high (wiki.gg ferry table, about 26h30). Helsinki–Tallinn gets an evidence note (about 2h30). No Rostock–Helsinki ferry was found, so none is added. Klaipėda–Kiel and Klaipėda–Karlshamn could not be confirmed or disproved and are kept at medium.

No DLC attribution, coordinate or name errors found beyond the above. No base-game rework from 1.50 to 1.58, and not Iceland (Nov 2026), touches this region. The graph is checked: 48 cities, 99 edges, connected, and every city has at least 2 edges.
